verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog documents all three elements of the story for initiatives: statuses including Proposed and Canceled, Priority to communicate which initiatives matter most, and the ability to assign a lead team that owns the work. Private-team-led initiatives add access control on top, and the homepage positions initiatives as a planning surface for product teams. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs beyond changelog snippets (e.g. the full status set and priority levels), and independent or hands-on corroboration of initiative tracking.
